lines: Every business starts the same way — with a list of people and a story worth sharing.
First, your list. Write down everyone you know. Don't pre-judge who's interested — just write.
Think in circles: family, friends, coworkers, and anyone whose number is in your phone.
Aim for at least one hundred names. Your list is the fuel for your whole business.
Next, your story. People don't join a company — they join a person with a why.
Your story is three simple parts: where you were, what you found, and where you're going.
Keep it under sixty seconds. Honest and short beats polished and long, every time.
Practice it out loud until it feels natural. Your story is your most powerful tool.
A full list and a clear story — that's a business ready to launch.
Next, we learn exactly how to invite people to take a look. Let's go.
